scope: Bounded independent review of source-measurement, recording-regime and cached public-signal evidence. No labels, raw data, predictions or models decoded; no numerical experiment, network access, new vector, scoring or upload.
conclusion: The retained evidence supports no genuinely distinct source mechanism with credible several-second incremental headroom. Do not reopen a closed pilot or consume a slot on an unsupported variation. This is a bounded evidence conclusion, not proof that all useful signals are exhausted.

reasons.evidence: Historical raw audit already identifies the large schedule-copy/day-shift regimes and nearly all useful mixed-ID twins. All matched labels obey endpoint subtraction; hidden departure endpoints in both releases remain absent. Shared-clock generator phase is unidentifiable.
reasons.disconfirmation: Paired-release noise-conditioning ideal scale is about0.0554 seconds under extra symmetry assumptions; no departure-specific observable supplies the missing coefficient.

reasons.evidence: Selected daily/runway totals already use the principal measured information. Source reference-population residuals, uncertain calendars, cross-date cells, fractional punctuality, count/sum supports and prior-odds adaptation have explicit prior screens.
reasons.disconfirmation: Reference-coherence source pilot is essentially flat in January and worse in July; numerical integration refinements supply no new observation.

reasons.mechanism: Correlated recording modes or dynamic ground peers
reasons.evidence: The latest honest airline/day mode pilot finds positive point estimates but fails both interval gates and July permutation p=.06. Spatial temporal-peer speed loses to static spatial controls on both fixed dates.
reasons.disconfirmation: Neither provides the predeclared evidence needed for a new model. Inconclusive evidence is not proof of independence; no alternate grouping or threshold proposed.

reasons.evidence: ATFM/CTOT adherence and predeparture-delay series already appear in the October10 cached source assessment; they are not a newly discovered signal. The only recorded0.77-second external claim bundles multiple inputs on a materially weaker model, with incomplete held-month availability evidence.
reasons.disconfirmation: No isolated selected-stack benefit, complete openly usable individual source coverage or several-second headroom has been established. Historical source terms are recorded in the cited report; this review makes no new legal or current-access determination.

cost_and_validation.recommended_cost: None on these mechanisms without genuinely new evidence.
cost_and_validation.reopening_evidence_required: A previously unused deployment-available measurement with reproducible row/day linkage and full Jan/Jul source coverage, plus a mechanistic reason that it resolves retained conditional error rather than duplicates known clocks/totals. Freeze one source-only availability/alias/population test first; only after passing, allocate a fixed Jan/Jul comparison against the actual retained candidate, with all rows, full provenance and independent auditing.
cost_and_validation.disconfirming_gate: Missing either held-month coverage, inability to distinguish source population from target population, or exact overlap with an already closed mechanism ends the lead before fitting.

search.limitation: No fresh internet discovery was performed; cached public-source reviews cannot establish what new material might have appeared since they were written.
